content: Takis tata kari Zacchaeus ko dugu duap
Jesus Jericho wonong ningi kasu naguram ale wonong kaoram ale namawaram.
Se sor mu ko kari bo, ko nup Zacchaeus; nu takis tata kari nunga supuling bo, nu kari kumik manga mel suen biya ago.
Noko gomang mu Jesus kari aguwaya wore arigokko, bare nu kari tukunang gotek se kariimet suen biya tala, se nu Jesus arigokko me terong.
Se nu naguram giri giri namaram ale lage Jesus te tairukko mu te tam sycamore masan mu aragam ale kuali bagakaso.
Se Jesus tai tam mu duap te aratam, ale kuali loagaram mu nu arigam ale maonam, “Zacchaeus, ni tairatela tai kaparko. Ani aitakta mu nika kawam te tairikko,” mam.
Se Zacchaeus tairatela tai kaparam ale amilmil te Jesus aru tagiram ale ilak ko kawam te namaram.
Se kariimet mel mu arigiman ale nging ngung kitikituk makasan ale balukasan, “Nu kari memek ko tiran yawara iwita ilak namaram!” makasan.

Bare Zacchaeus barasu sanamaram ale Kari Biya maonam, “Arikko, Kari Biya! Aitakta mu ani aga melmasak suen la kusumuri pagik, ale komasang mu kariimet kituwura guat nungarikko. Ale ani kari i bo kawel munan te ko mel i giek agi mu, ani ko moke tom 4 ko gira awom la nungarikkowo,” mam.
Se Jesus nu maonam, “Aitakta imi te Kaem kawam digo imi lilim sangaru tam, mu awuk, kari imi betela Abraham ko namar bo tala.
Kari ko Namar tairam mu awiriya sarenga yumu namara wore kupok ale arigok ale sangaru taukko tairam,” mam.
Kari dom ko ura kari 10 wore manga nungaram ko den pangan

Se nuna den umu ikiwaman, mu nu den kunasaram ale den pangan bo nunga maonam, mu awuk, nu Jerusalem duap te pingi bagara se nu ikiam mu nuna ikikasan, Kaem ko kingdom mu aitakta wetang te aratu saparuk se arigimonko iwita ikikasan. Bare uwuta mena.
Se nu den pangan umu duap beteram ale mam, “Kari biya bo nu sor bo awar wore te namaruk se king ko betemon se aking peleruk tairukko.

Se nu ko ura kari nunga ningi 10 nunga auram se taiman, se manga paogam ale suan suan nuguting te awu awu ago namaram. Ale nunga maonam, ‘Nina manga imi tal ale ura te bita se bagaral, se ani pelerik tairikko,’ mam.
“Bare noko wonong suan mu nu am me ta ko amilmilaman, ale kari sang nunga manorman, se nu kowom karomon namamon ale balmon, ‘Ana kari imi anananga king bagarukko me ta ko amilmilasan,’ mamonko.
“Bare nuna am king ko beteman, se peleram tairam. Asele nu ko ura kari manga nungaram mu taimon se manga aguwaya ura te beteman wore ko nunga isuokko den beteram.
“Se kari giram tairam mu mam, ‘Kari dom, ani manga suanta aisem
mu ani te ura beterem, ale ko marir manga 10 ko awote taem,’ mam.
“Se kari dom mu mam, ‘Ni ura kari ningo, se ura yawarakala beterem! Ni mel gotektir imi gemang ningi nunguning te beterem, bore te se, ni aitak wonong bibiya 10 nunga bitaruko,’ mam.
“Se ura kari bo aking tairam ale mam, ‘Kari dom, ni manga suanta ani aisem mu ura te beterem, ale ko marir manga 5 ko awote taem,’ mam.
Se kari dom mu mam, ‘Ni wonong bibiya 5 nunga bitaruko ka betesam,’ mam.
“Se ura kari bo tala aking tairam ale mam, ‘Kari dom,’ mam, ‘ka manga aisem mu iweya. Ani guang bilik te kalem ale kaluwu beterem se aniram.
Mu awuk, ni kari aora biya se ani nika nguangerem. Ni mel saki nika mena wore am karogo tasam. Ale mel kari sang agusan bare ni ko nunguning am gisam tala,’ mam.

“Se kari dom mu mam, ‘Ni ura kari memek! Ani ni keta ka den balem sumu karo tuek ale nanamara kisekko,’ mam. ‘Ni balem ani kari aora biya maem. Ale ani mel saki aninga mena bare am karogo gisam maem, mel kari sang agusan bare ko nunguning ani am gisam tala maem.
Ni uwuta ikiem agi mu, awuk se ni aninga manga bank te me beterem? Ni uwuta beterem le mu, ani pelerem tairem ale manga mu to se, ko marir manga karogo taem le,’ mam.
“Ale kari pipingi sanami se animan mu nunga maonam, ‘Manga kuting te sumu tal, ale karogo nama ura manga 10 karogo bagoso mu tualko,’ mam.
“Bare nuna balman, ‘Kari dom, ura kari umu nu maingkala manga 10 karogo terong ma la bagoso!’ maman.
“Se nu mam, ‘Ani ninga manorsam, awiriya mel karogo mu, nuna sang karogotala tumonko, bare awiriya mel mena mu, katirta gotek kumik te aniso mu kumik te gi sapamon se kumik mel mena biya bagarukko.
Se kari memek alo, ani nononga king ko me aratik ale nunga bituekko balman, mu nunga gial arungak tairal ale ani amakete nunga moral se kuemonko!’ ”
Jesus king iwita Jerusalem ningi kasu naguram
Jesus den umu balu saparam ale giram Jerusalem nama tarigikaso.
Nu nama Bethphage se Bethany wonong te aratu se, duruk Olive masan mu te ko olekem ilagala nunga maonam,

“Nina ilagala giral wonong nemeke ko aniso mu te namaral ale kasu nagu se, mu donkey kulak gotek bo kalo beteman se bagoso mu arigalko, donkey gotek mu kari bo me gi arigam, mena, kumik lilim biya bagoso. Ko mayang kutuwural ale ilak aningate tairalko.
Se kariimet i bo ninga isuok, ‘Nina anape ko donkey sowore kutuwusan?’ mauk, mu nina maonalko, ‘Kari Biya ura te bitirukko balam se,’ malko.”
Se ilagala namaman ale mel suen la nu ko nunga maonam mu butata arigiman.
Nuna donkey ko mayang kutuwuwaman se ko kotam kotam nunga isarman, “Nina anape ko donkey kutuwusan a?” maman.
Se nuna nunga manorman, “Kari Biya ura te bitirukko balam se,” maman.
Asele donkey mu taman ale Jesus kote karogo namaman. Ale nunga guang saki kututuwu donkey awote awuman ale Jesus sangorman se araga te daigam.
Ale namawakaso mu, kariimet nunga guang kututuwu lage te murukasan se awote namakaso.

Nu tai Jerusalem aratu se duruk Olive luan kaoram kapawaram mu, kariimet nu kowom karowara, noko olekem ma nunga balsan, mu lilim la amilmil duap beteman, ale sail te aikasan ale ko miracle ari lagaman wore ko Kaem nup patawukasan.
Ale balukasan:

content.text: “Marak se amilmil yawara king Yawe ko
nup te taiso mu kote kaparukko!”
“Duruk wonong te lila yawara se ko
nikim sokel ago kalel biya anirukko!”

content: Se Pharisee sikina kariimet ningi bagaman mu Jesus manorman, “Kausa kari, nika olekem ining nungaru se nuguring kalomonko!” maman.
Se nu nunga den koma balam, “Ani ninga manorsam, ani nunga manik se nuguring kalomon, mu manga imi amilmilamonkowo!” mam.
Jesus Jerusalem wonong ko mononge kaparam
Se nu tai Jerusalem aratam ale wonong arigam mu mononge kapakaso,
se balam, “O Jerusalem, am ni day tom aitakta imi, nika marolila ningo karo taiwoso imi ko ari iki mu asele terong ko, bare mena, ni motam kaloman se sisiram se me arikko.
Bare tom bo taiwoso mu kapa kisok se kager memek utu nagurok, ka lautok ale koma suen la te ka maguwurokko.

Nuna ka por aora mu ita parusuwu ali karogo betemon ale ka kariimet nunga menawu sapamonko. Se ka manga bibiya te kalo lagerem mu suen la parasaruk kapa ali aruk, ale bo ta me pata se bagaruk se arigalko, mena. Mu awuk, tom Kaem nika ko tairam bare ni me ari ko ikiem.”
Jesus temple ningi kasu naguram
Se Jesus temple ningi kasu naguram ale kari melmasak dia gurugu se animan mu nunga karo parusuwuram.
Ale nunga maonam, “Batoga te aniso: ‘Aninga temple mu guranek ko kawam anirukko’, bare nina guruguman ale ‘tere kari nunga kawam’ iwita betesan.”

Jesus tom suen biya temple ningi kariimet den nunga kasurukaso. Se priest bibiya, se law ko kausa kari, se kariimet nunga kari bibiya, nuna lage bo arigimon ale nu te momon se kuerukko wore ko loagakasan.
Bare kariimet suen biya noko den ikimonko ninguru sail tagikasan. Buta se nuna lage nu te momonko mu me arikasan.

footnotes.text: Jesus kariimet nunga sangaru taukko tairam: John 3:17; 1 Timothy 1:15.
Den pangan baluwoso iwitatala, tom nukum te Jesus king iwita peleruk tairukko.
